title: Collatz: integer fibres, real separation, and positive pressure quasimodes
body:
## Checkpoint 15 — 23 November 2026

**Full Collatz remains OPEN.** The latest repo results make the missing tasks concrete: exclude an exact positive ordinary pressure eigenvector, control numerical cancellation in the complete cycle denominator, or construct an original-target merger. This checkpoint attempts those implications directly. It gives a corrected simultaneous-value theorem with a Lean real-gap bridge, positive known-basin quasimodes, and exact diagnostics of two other closing arguments.

## 1. Agreement in the real and 3-adic completions forces an actual cycle

For an infinite binary code with one-positions d_i, suppose the 3-adic sum of
`S_k = sum_(i=1)^k 3^(i-1)/2^(d_i+1)`
is a positive odd ordinary integer q. Its tails reconstruct actual positive odd unit inverse states. The same real series converges to B<=q, and the new written theorem proves:

```text
B=q  iff the supplied inverse itinerary stays forever on the actual cycle of q.

If q is nonperiodic, then q-B >= q*exp(-200/3) > 0
for every such binary code.
```

Nonperiodic includes an ordinary integer that later reaches the known cycle. A cycle-exiting inverse path has a strict gap with its finite initial cycle product retained. The equality alternative still allows a hypothetical nontrivial positive integer cycle.

The proof extends PR177's elementary cylinder count to simple inverse rays, giving at most 5*X^(39/40) vertices below X and reciprocal sum at most 200. No canonical-envelope, population, entropy, or mixing premise enters.

[Complete written theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c82e3c1be894f655b40dcb61bf6d309a8f664e67/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/integer-boundary/TWO_PLACE_NUMEN_CLASSIFICATION.md) · [Lean source](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c82e3c1be894f655b40dcb61bf6d309a8f664e67/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/integer-boundary/lean/InverseRealSeparation.lean)

**Formal boundary:** Lean proves 10 theorems and 3 definitions, including the literal dyadic-series limit and quantitative gap from the explicit finite reciprocal-budget premise. The integer cylinder count, 3-adic reconstruction, and complete periodic classification are written proofs, not supplied as Lean axioms or claimed fully formalized.

## 2. The unrestricted numen-root closing premise is false

Every positive odd 3-unit has continuum many irrational binary numen preimages. At each step choose either of two strictly increasing ordinary inverse branches with gaps between 3 and 8. For root 1, one ray starts:

```text
1, 5, 13, 277, 1477, 7877, 21005, ...
```

Its 3-adic series equals 1, while its real sum is at most 1/5. An irrational numen preimage therefore does not imply forward escape.

This directly contradicts the particular converse in Theorem 2.7 of [Siegel, arXiv:2412.02902v1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2412.02902). The inspected proof infers rationality of a given preimage from existence of some rational preimage. The note retains the exact normalization and source pages. This is one scoped correction, not a review or rejection of the dissertation's other analytic machinery.

[Construction and precise source boundary](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c82e3c1be894f655b40dcb61bf6d309a8f664e67/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/integer-boundary/NUMEN_INVERSE_FIBER.md)

## 3. Positive pressure quasimodes already occur in the known basin of 1

For the actual weighted ordinary operator
`A_s h(n)=(3/2^a(n))^s h(U(n))`,
every s>1 and 0<=t<s-1 admit nonnegative f_k supported entirely on integers proved to reach 1, with

```text
||f_k||_t = 1,
||(I-A_s)f_k||_t <= 2^t*(2/3)^((s-t)k) -> 0,
dist(f_k, ker(I-A_s)) = 1,
where ||h||_t = sum n^t*|h(n)|.
```

Hence I-A_s has nonclosed range and is not Fredholm in these weighted Wiener spaces. Positive finite-support approximants also exist. This is a different operator and positivity statement from PR175's unweighted Hardy pushforward results.

The approximate vectors do not obey one fixed C*n^(-s) envelope. Exact positive-kernel exclusion under that envelope remains open.

[Written spectral theorem and exact mixed equation](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c82e3c1be894f655b40dcb61bf6d309a8f664e67/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/integer-boundary/PRESSURE_WIENER_ATTACK.md) · [Standalone analytic question](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c82e3c1be894f655b40dcb61bf6d309a8f664e67/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/integer-boundary/WEIGHTED_FUNCTIONAL_QUESTION.txt)

A fourth agent initially received only that analytic question. Its independent attack derives `g_(64n+21)=g_n`, with `g_n=(n+1/3)^2 h_n`, and the exact differentiated mixed equation. A nonzero solution therefore lacks the critical little-o coefficient decay and Hardy-H1 second Euler derivative that would prove uniqueness. The attempted regularity bootstrap did not establish either premise. Its rederived escape equivalence is credited to existing project input.

[Independent continuation](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c82e3c1be894f655b40dcb61bf6d309a8f664e67/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/integer-boundary/INDEPENDENT_KERNEL_ATTACK.md)

## 4. A mandatory-band diagnostic at the entire binary horizon

For every k>=2, put `q=2^(3k)+2^(2k+1)-1` and `a=3k`. Then

```text
(a+1)*(q-2^a) <= 4*2^a,
T^j(q) > q for every 1<=j<=a.
```

Thus even this exponentially thin relative band does not force descent by the entire common-bit horizon. The note keeps three missing resources distinct: a remainder below the original least bad input, a certificate fitting that horizon, and a saving below the unchanged original input. This is a diagnostic, not a new universal descent estimate or an assertion that these examples diverge.

[Full source attempt and all-parameter proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/c82e3c1be894f655b40dcb61bf6d309a8f664e67/research/lean-global-resolvent-20261121/overview/integer-boundary/BAND_REMAINDER_CLOSURE_ATTEMPT.md)

- Pressure controls: six actual convergent trajectories, 2,814 branch-filter cases, 24,008 exact rational coefficient comparisons.
- Numen controls: 512 exact prefixes, six residue cases, three rejected damaged-prefix controls.
- Band controls: 127 full-horizon cases and eight explicitly convergent pairs.

- Independent written reconstructions cover the pressure theorem, both numen arguments, and the Lean statements' semantic scope. Coordinating contributions and late formatting bindings are disclosed.
